$$abc = 4(a+b+c) + 2(ab+bc+ca)$$

Rearranging: $abc - 2(ab+bc+ca) - 4(a+b+c) = 0$.

## Substitution

Let $x = a-2,\ y = b-2,\ z = c-2$, so $x,y,z \geq -1$ and $s = x+y+z+6$. Expanding:

$$(a-2)(b-2)(c-2) = abc - 2(ab+bc+ca) + 4(a+b+c) - 8$$

So $abc - 2(ab+bc+ca) = (a-2)(b-2)(c-2) - 4(a+b+c) + 8$. Substituting into our equation:

$$(a-2)(b-2)(c-2) - 4(a+b+c) + 8 - 4(a+b+c) = 0$$
$$xyz = 8(a+b+c) - 8 = 8s - 8 = 8(x+y+z+6) - 8 = 8(x+y+z) + 40$$

Thus: **$xyz = 8(x+y+z) + 40$**, with $x,y,z \geq -1$.

## Bounding

$$x^2 z \leq xyz = 8(x+y+z)+40 \leq 24z + 40$$
